reviews.author: James Jr. Gantzen
reviews.text: Bruce's automotive repair team is the best I've ever encountered. Their quality workmanship goes well above and beyond. Their very diligent, conscientious, transparent, honest, reliable, authentic and uphold the utmost highest standards in the industry. This family owned business prides itself on delivering exceptional service and value. I will drive/tow way out of my area to utilize their repair services for future appointments. They always keep the client's best interests in mind. They even performed additional work as a free courtesy, to boot! Best vehicular Southern Hospitality in the entire state, period!!!!!!!

reviews.author: coleman morrow
reviews.text: Guys did an amazing job with my true dual exhaust. The setup was done clean and the routing is perfect, the tailpipes were positioned exactly where I wanted them and the chrome tips look sharp. The price was higher than expected, BUT the quality of work is reflected in that, made it well worth it for a good job

reviews.author: Christian Littrell
reviews.text: I have had three separate jobs done on my vehicles and all of them fell through within a few days. #1, The new exhaust on my truck completely disconnected from the manifold a week after they put it in. I fixed it myself. #2, I had a new leaf spring put in the same truck months later and the bolts they put in were way too long and gouged themselves into the shackle mounts, causing constant creaking and groaning. Still dealing with that. #3, had true dual exhaust put in on one of my classics and the hanger fell out of the car while on my way to work. Muffler hit the road and ruined it. They must have high schoolers working there because the lack of care really stands out more than anything. Will not be using them again.

reviews.author: Christie Peterson
reviews.text: I am beyond impressed with the service I received! The quality of work done on my car was exceptional, every detail was handled with great expertise. The service was incredibly fast without compromising quality, and their communication was clear, prompt, and very professional throughout the entire process. I truly appreciated their honesty and transparency, which gave me complete peace of mind. On top of all that, their prices were very reasonable and fair. I highly recommend this team to anyone seeking trustworthy, high-quality, and efficient car service!

reviews.author: John S
reviews.text: used high mile truck, tail pipe hanging by electrical wire. they cut out the "muffler delete" so the pipe hangers would meet the hanger, welded it all back up, cut the end off & put a tip on it. quick, fast, great price!!!

reviews.author: Lady Bug
reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience with Bruce's. The quality of work done on my car was absolutely top-notch, everything was handled with great care and precision. Their service was incredibly speedy, getting my car back on the road faster than I expected. Communication throughout the process was excellent; I was kept informed every step of the way, which made me feel confident and valued as a customer. What truly stood out was their honesty and transparency, along with very fair and competitive pricing. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable, high-quality auto service! Thank You Dakota.

reviews.author: Johnny Shaw
reviews.text: Awesome job! Called and got an appointment for the same week. Dropped it off at 0800, talked about what I wanted, full exhaust from header to tailpipe for a '67 International Scout 800. Was done by the end of lunch! Work is excellent, prices are great, definitely will have my future business.

reviews.author: Miranda Whitlock
reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience with this shop! The service performed on my vehicle was excellent, Dakota was professional, and the pricing was very fair. They went above and beyond to make sure everything was done right, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality automotive service!

reviews.author: Bruce H.
reviews.text: We took our 27yo Chrysler Sebring convertible here for a rattle. That is a tough challenge but this family owned and run business took it on, and, resolved the issue with just two visits. The catalytic converter was shelled out and the right rear brake shoe was metal on metal and the brake line clogged along with other issues. Their service/repair costs are reasonable, and they are honest and dependable. After 10 years living in Berkeley County, I've finally found my trusted auto repair service with reasonable labor rates and trustworthy experienced mechanics. Our 27yo car drives solid now and we're loving our beach trips, top down, once again, thanks to the Driggers family.

reviews.author: Conner Anderson
reviews.text: Took my firebird in for spark plugs to be changed and an unknown sound. They found the issue and redid the spark plugs/ coils for me for a very reasonable price as well. Would recommend for anyone who cares for their vehicles to take to Bruce’s auto !

reviews.author: Sabrina Cobin
reviews.text: I took my Honda Accord to Bruce’s. I needed a diagnostic. I thought it was something that was going to be expensive but it ended up not being expensive. First time taking my car there. Happy to say they didn’t try to take advantage of me because I’m a woman. They have gained my trust.

reviews.author: Sandra Cumbee
reviews.text: Best auto repair shop in the Berkeley County area! They are reliable, honest, and knowledgeable. Plus a family owned business! They will always have my business.

reviews.author: Michael Renne
reviews.text: Met Bruce and the guys from being a driver at Parks Auto Parts delivering alot of parts to them. Great group of guys!! Honest, hardworking, and very knowledgeable!! I would recommend them to any of my friends or family!! Reasonable prices and just all around do a great job!!!

reviews.author: Ralston Hall
reviews.text: I’m out of town working and needed a tire changed and everywhere was booked. I went over to Bruce’s and they jumped off what they was doing and got my tire changed so I could go to work. Very good people. I highly recommend theses guys and will come back to only them if I need anything automotive related while I’m here!!!

reviews.author: Tristina
reviews.text: Bruce's is the only place I will take my Tacoma. The guys there are down to earth, honest, hard working dudes and have been very solid on providing great quality and price for their work. I've had my husband's exhaust pipe replaced and welded, my radiator replaced, oil changed, air conditioner charged, and more. I only trust these guys to help me keep my truck going for many more years. You won't regret giving Bruce's your money and time.

reviews.author: Sherlyn Johnson
reviews.text: I was referred to Bruce's Auto & Muffler by a family friend. Mr. Bruce and his crew took awesome care of my vehicle in a reasonable time frame! They did a wonderful job and I would definitely recommend them, keep up the great work you guys!!!!

reviews.author: Matt Jones
reviews.text: Nothing shy of amazing, told them what I wanted and they had it finished in less than a day. All welds are nice and neat truck sounds amazing! For the work they did you can’t beat the price! Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Jim Mackall
reviews.text: Had an issue with my exhaust system. Thought I was going to need an entire new system. I was wrong. Fast Service, Fair Price, and most importantly honest.

reviews.author: Dawn Harmsen
reviews.text: The shop down the road was going to try to charge me TWICE as much as Bruce’s. Maybe because I’m a woman? Bruce will get all of my business and everyone I know will hear about this! Thanks so much!

reviews.author: Kevin O'Quinn
reviews.text: It doesn't matter what I need for my vehicles. Bruce, Dakota and the rest take very good care of me. Great people and great service!!!!

reviews.author: Ron Whisner
reviews.text: Would like to acknowledge Bruce’s garage for helping me with my issue for my 2016 canyon. Thank you again for saving me time and money !!

reviews.author: Bird Dog
reviews.text: Just stopped in on way through in the hopes they could fix my muffler which was falling off. They had a rack available, cut old welded new replacing pipe. Caught them at a good time was back on the road in about 30 mins. Very good place they know what they are doing and fair prices.

reviews.author: James Brown
reviews.text: I’ve taken my Jeep here a few times now and I have to say these guys are amazing. I always feel like I got a fair deal and they are super nice. Recommend Bruce 100%

reviews.author: Randy Heyward
reviews.text: I wouldn't recommend this place. This place charged my parents 500 dollars for a job that wasn't completed. I wouldn't recommend this place, even for a 10-speed bicycle.

reviews.author: Sherry Sparks
reviews.text: Great techs and great service!!! Can't say enough about this business!!! Always very pleased with the service we receive!!!!!

reviews.author: Jason Beltz
reviews.text: These guys are great! A solid local business with friendly and honest employees. They will have my business again.

reviews.author: Jonathan Sanchez
reviews.text: Bruce's will get you going. It is always a pleasure to stop by this place. Come see these guys for all your Automotive needs and maintenance.
